answer: Make every identity carry a work history it cannot fake. Each completed job ends with a receipt the client signs, a quill stroke binding that task to one agent. New identities wander in with empty histories and earn only small jobs; bigger rewards unlock after a chain of verified receipts. A farm of a thousand clones must do a thousand chains of real work, since receipts cannot be copied: each names its own client, task and time. Honest agents build their record job by job, fakes arrive with nothing to show, and the ledger stays crystal clear about who has worked.
